Commercial content, made unmistakable

Screens 12–13. The moment a vendor can post something that looks like a method card, the corpus loses its meaning. Commercial content here carries a hatched ground, a permanent label and a different type treatment — and it can never enter the artifact graph, be cited, or appear in a federated search result alongside community work.

FOUR SIMULTANEOUS SIGNALS
Hatched ground — visible in peripheral vision and in greyscale
Dashed border — every community artifact has a solid one
Sans-serif headline — the corpus uses mono for artifact titles
Two labels — a banner and a chip, neither dismissible
Redundancy is the point. Any one signal can be missed by a tired reader at 23:00; four cannot.

SALARY IS MANDATORY · NO EXCEPTIONS
A range, in a currency, or the post does not publish. "Competitive" and "commensurate with experience" are not accepted values. Salary secrecy in academic hiring disadvantages exactly the people the platform's early-career space exists to protect.
Each post shows the lab's own record — outputs, null results published, whether people who left were given handover packs. A candidate can evaluate the group, not just the advertisement.

12b RECRUITER TALENT SEARCH (M18) — CONSENT-GATED 640 × 600
COMMERCIAL FEATURE · RECRUITER SEAT
RECRUITERS CANNOT SEARCH THE MEMBERSHIP
They can only search the 412 people who explicitly opted in to being found for opportunities. The other 22,000 accounts are not merely hidden from the results — they are not in the searchable set at all, and no filter combination reveals a count of them.
WHAT A CANDIDATE CONTROLS
Findable for opportunities
Show my current institution
Allow industry recruiters, not only academic
Off by default, expires after six months, and prompts for renewal rather than silently persisting. Someone who was job-hunting in 2026 should not still be findable in 2029.
EVERY CONTACT IS LOGGED AND VISIBLE TO THE CANDIDATE
"Novartis viewed your profile via recruiter search on 14 September" appears in the candidate's own activity, with a one-click block. The asymmetry of recruiter tooling is the thing that makes people leave professional networks.
Rate limits apply. Twenty approaches per recruiter per month, and a recruiter whose messages are reported twice loses the seat. The quarantine applies to them exactly as it does to anyone else.
